Exact match first, then lower-cased match restricted to is_custom rows: keeps generated base62 codes case-sensitive while making aliases case-insensitive; Expiry evaluated at read time: no background job needed; exact to the request; In-process bounded queue + batch writer: keeps DB writes off the redirect path; drops (and counts) on overflow instead of adding latency; visitor = sha256(HMAC(secret, day) + ip + ua): unique visitors per day without storing PII; salts rotate daily so hashes cannot be joined across days; Retention purge on a timer (analytics_retention_days): compliance policy CMP-003

Additive and reversible: a nullable column and a new table with a composite (link_id, day) index for the stats queries. SQLite needs batch mode for ALTER, Postgres does not; env.py selects it. The clicks table has no IP or user-agent column by design.
